tasks.title: Build universal request-routing and execution gateway
tasks.objective: Deliver a runnable host-invoked gateway that maps arbitrary user objectives to bounded tool capabilities and either ephemeral work or durable Pro-Papa tasks, with honest receipts and permissions; never claim automatic ChatGPT interception.
acceptance: A documented, runnable entry point accepts arbitrary general user objectives, maps supported needs to typed/capability-scoped handlers or general fallback, and selects ephemeral vs tracked execution without adding routine requests to the framework roadmap

Untrusted task text and external data cannot authorize shell commands, new tools, credentials, publishing, destructive actions, or unapproved side effects; tool/action authorization is explicit and tested

Execution emits structured outcomes, genuine tool-operation provenance, truthful failure/resume state, and opt-in private usage receipts via existing PP-0004 contract; receipt issuance never stands in for actual task execution
Negative and integration tests cover unknown domains, duplicate requests/retries, unavailable tool providers, unauthorized actions, privacy, receipt failures, and durable task-state isolation

tasks.title: Deliver a real host integration with enforced audit gates

acceptance: A supported, runnable reference host accepts user requests, invokes the gateway and configured authorized handlers, returns results and preserves per-project state when tracking is needed

When private auditing is enabled for gateway traffic, the host records the live repository read and verifiable receipt or clearly fails/reports degraded mode; it cannot claim a verified receipt without a matching private GitHub commit and readback

Document supported integration surfaces and whether current ChatGPT Projects can actually invoke this host; if native turn interception is unavailable, demonstrate the independent app/runner path instead of claiming universal enforcement in ChatGPT

Demonstrate real authorized tool execution and private-audit smoke tests plus adversarial tests for permissions, failures, partial writes, concurrent requests, idempotent resume and no sensitive prompt logging

tasks.title: Validate cross-domain outcomes and benchmark workflow overhead
tasks.objective: Prove the implemented gateway/host improves real user tasks across domains with verified evidence and measured cost, without treating receipt creation as proof of reasoning or answer quality.
acceptance: Run reproducible end-to-end requests across at least six representative categories: quick Q&A, sourced research, software, document creation, calculation/data analysis, and planning or operations, including a novel/fallback request

For each pilot distinguish executed tools, persisted task/evidence where relevant, real audit receipts and substantive output validation; include deliberate negative cases for unauthorized operations, unavailable tools and inaccurate receipts
Report outcome quality, task completion rate, corrective interactions, latency/tool-call or token overhead where measurable, and limitations compared with a simple direct-assistant baseline
Publish reproducible test fixtures and results, pass exact-head CI, and obtain genuine independent review before task closure or assertions of readiness
